integrity: The proof transforms the exact two-coefficient Schur parameterization through the source coefficient identities, then supplies converse realization by solving the defining even-odd differential relations. The scalar lower and upper moduli-difference endpoints are exact one-variable extrema of the resulting disk fibers. No finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the joint first-two inverse logarithmic coefficient bodies for the two Sakaguchi symmetric-point classes. It does not determine the joint body involving the third coefficient. One September 2026 article on logarithmic coefficients of the same classes is subscription-only in its full version; its public abstract does not state the joint inverse-logarithmic body, so an access-related residual literature risk remains.
title: Exact first-two inverse logarithmic coefficient bodies for Sakaguchi symmetric classes
